text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, can I drop by my workplace for a<n>second? It's
just around the corner.

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We arrive to find Daitaku Helios and<n>Mejiro Palmer
with Ines Fujin's<n>managers for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Huh?! N-no, not at all! It's just, well...You know... Right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Right! We're, like, looking for work!<n>Right, Helios?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Uh... W-we so are?! It's vibes right<n>now 'cause the
manager hooked us<n>up?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, gotcha. So... You're having some<n>kind of work
fair?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I can help out with this! I mean, I<n>literally work
part-time at these places<n>myself.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So, for example...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
At a ramen shop, your main tasks<n>would be taking
orders, serving<n>bowls, and cleaning!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And the trick to a good greeting is to<n>keep it curt
and clear! Just copy how<n>the director speaks and
you'll sound<n>fine. ♪

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
The voice Fu uses when she speaks<n>to customers
is amazing! Some of our<n>customers order extra just
to hear it<n>again!
choice_data_list: What's it like working at a convenience store?
What's it like working at a convenience store?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You'll mostly be stacking shelves<n>and working the
register. Nothing too<n>hard as long as your customer
service skills are decent!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and you get to speak to a whole<n>host of
customers! It's really a great<n>way to connect with
the local<n>community!

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
And we also get huge lines of people<n>all hoping to
connect with you, Fu!<n>That's really something you
should<n>be proud of.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Whoa, you guys! I feel like<n>you're talking
more about me than<n>the job!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I do get the sense that the topic of<n>conversation has
shifted from the<n>nature of the job to praising Ines
Fujin's work ethic...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh! There should be one more<n>opening too... It's for
an<n>early-morning job, so maybe that's<n>why
nobody's here to advertise it?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, the job's flyer distribution!<n>The company
I've been working for<n>has been really good to me
ever<n>since I started way back!

text_block_list.name: Helios & Palmer
text_block_list.text: You're...

text_block_list.name: Helios & Palmer
text_block_list.text: Sooo goated!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I knew you'd been working, like, a lotof part-time jobs, but I didn't knowyou were such a total pro! Man, weare so not worthy of your presence!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Um, what? You're definitely going a<n>little too far
there...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Or maybe not?! Actually, I totally<n>agree!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Maybe you should call me the<n>Part-Time Pro! In
fact... I want<n>everyone here to revere me!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, let's start by having you<n>address me as
"Boss Ines."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! I'm kidding, I'm kidding! But<n>still...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If you do end up working with me, I<n>promise I'll
show you the ropes.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want you guys to have a good<n>experience, and to
make things easier<n>for my bosses.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: With me around, you'll be pro<n>workers in no time!
choice_data_list: Spoken like a true Part-Time Pro.
Spoken like a true Part-Time Pro.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: With me around, you'll be pro<n>workers in no time!
choice_data_list: Spoken like a true Part-Time Pro.
Spoken like a true Part-Time Pro.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you know it! None of that stuff<n>on my
resume is there for show.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, how many top employees do<n>you think I've
already trained from<n>the ground up? Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, it's this late already?! I need<n>to get to my
next shift!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oho? Thinking about getting a<n>part-time job,
Trainer? Knowing how<n>skilled you are, I think I could
use<n>your help.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No, wait—you can't! You'd end up<n>way too busy if
you started juggling<n>jobs!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No matter what you're doing, you<n>should never
push yourself too hard.<n>♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, it's this late already?! I need<n>to get to my
next shift!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
All right, you guys have got this! And<n>I'll see you
around, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Stop right there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Like, sorry for the secrecy, but the<n>truth is we really
really wanted to<n>discuss something with you,
Trainer...
